mandated_check: confirm the toolchain avoids native .node binaries in the Aside sandbox: next --webpack, Tailwind v3, npm i --ignore-scripts, PGlite as a standalone service
find PIDs with lsof -t on a file or port the process holds (ps, pgrep and pkill are blocked) and serve a fresh build on a fresh port instead of trusting :3000

trigger: (?i)(npm run build|next build|flutter build|xcodebuild|eas build|gradlew? assemble)
mandated_check: confirm exactly one builder runs for this project (no watcher routine or second agent building) and run long builds detached with nohup while polling the log
check the repo is registered with Mike's git hook before committing; registering an unregistered repo is Mike's call
sweep every consumer of the transformed keys in the same change and prove background endpoints with a forced-due fixture, because a clean exit with zero work is what a broken join looks like
return {rows} with array-mode rows from a pg-proxy callback, verified by a standalone query before wiring it into Next
env-gate each paid vendor with a NAMED fallback so the app runs without the key, and list missing credentials exactly in a BLOCKED list
prove the gate with a limit+1 deny test and show the counter moving in the rendered UI

after a fresh production build and next start, fetch every file under public/ and require HTTP 200 (next start serves only files present at build time), and compare the NEXT_PUBLIC_* names used in source with the built client bundle (a name still read as process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_* in .next/static was not inlined at build time)
click through the wasm feature in the production build and scope wasm-unsafe-eval to its path instead of weakening the global CSP
confirm every changed bundled asset URL is content-hashed and that the served URL changed, because an immutable cache on an unhashed URL keeps returning visitors on the old file
report a green preview as a render check only; functional proof that depends on the real domain waits for the Gate-D promote
prove production identity by sha256 of the live page against candidate deployment URLs, not by deploy metadata or CDN cache headers
after any env change, redeploy without build cache and confirm the new value is in effect on the served build
run simulator work from an Orca terminal (CoreSimulatorService is unreachable from the Aside sandbox) and cold shutdown, boot and uninstall before each capture run
use screenshots of the real app on a device or simulator and have a person or vision judge actually look; golden-test renders and pixel metrics are not visual QA
tap Not now or Skip on permission screens during automated runs and clear leftover system alerts with a cold simulator restart
confirm which backend the build talks to before automated sign-ups, then delete every created test account and poll deletion status until the user is gone
prove the shipped bundle's compile-time flags from the bundle itself (for example dart2js dead-branch string counts) before trusting any QA run against it
grep the runner behind any PASS report for assertion verbs (expect, assert) and hardcoded status literals before quoting its counts
classify a check that could not run (missing tool, dependency or credential) as BLOCKED with the missing piece named, never as FAILED or PASS
check in-app account deletion (Apple 5.1.1(v)), purchases that transact (3.1.1), metadata the app can back (2.3.1), no dead buttons (Play IN_APP_EXPERIENCE) and live crash reporting before submission
confirm a UI defect on the rendered screen and find the enclosing conditional before reporting it; source proves code exists, not that it renders
read the persisted record back through a different path before claiming an endpoint stored it
curl the exact local URL for a 200 and the expected content before claiming a local surface is up; a keepalive supervisor does not prove liveness
keep watcher routines read-only (they never build) and delete them at mission close so they do not become silently dead routines
checksum the target before and after each plant and refuse a plant whose bytes did not move
write each new failure into this ledger as a typed lesson and patch the owning sub-skill in the same session; memory-only lessons do not count
confirm an owner process picked the task up before reporting dispatched work as started; an accepted receipt is not a running worker
write single-line quoted scalars, unanchored grep checks and agent ids with .md, reindex before test, and execute done_when directly when the CLI index is stale
probe the builder CLI with a one-line real completion before dispatch and read the launcher startup record; a blocking launcher gate means using the next builder in the pinned chain
do not rely on an agent's own sandbox inside the Aside sandbox: run it in its configured mode with secrets scrubbed from its env, one folder in scope, and a hard time cap
unset PYTHONHOME and PYTHONPATH before a child process starts a different Python, because the Aside runtime exports its own and the system python then dies with No module named encodings
compare each run's duration and evidence with the work it claims; a multi-phase build that completes in seconds, or evidence hashed from placeholder strings, is a stub and not a result
search ~/Desktop/Projects and the Memory OS studio map as well as the capability index before building, because the capability index does not cover project folders

reproduce a hydration mismatch on first load and after client navigation, then fix the diverging value at its source (a mounted gate, skipHydration with an explicit rehydrate, one shared formatter, or a client-only import); suppressHydrationWarning is allowed only on the one element whose value the server cannot know (the theme attribute), never to hide a data mismatch

one failed request never blanks a screen or replaces the app with a raw error popup: check response.ok on every fetch, render an in-page error state for the failed section only, and make every catch fix, rethrow or log with context; prove it by forcing one request to fail and capturing the rest of the screen still rendered

wire error monitoring for the API and the client before the first release and prove one induced error reaches it with request and session context; with no monitoring key, log structured errors with the same context as the named fallback and list the monitoring key in the release request

validate required configuration once at server start and fail loud with the variable name (never at module import, which breaks every importer); give optional paid keys a named fallback; before debugging code, prove the key loads in the runtime that calls it by restarting with caches cleared and reading it where it is used
run the production build after each slice, not only at the end, and treat every lint, type, key or hydration warning as a failure to fix or to waive by name before calling the build clean

verify each feature on the real surface: drive one real request in a browser with the network tab open (a real device or the store sandbox for mobile and purchases) and record the request, the response and the rendered result; code reading, a running server or a simulator run is not evidence

every middleware, server action and route handler ends each path with next(), a response or a rethrow: an Express error handler declares four parameters, a server-action catch rethrows after recording, and a hung request or a swallowed redirect is reproduced with one request before the fix

coerce form and query values (they arrive as strings) inside the schema before validating, read the parsed data only after the success check, and reject incomplete input server-side with a named error the UI shows; test one empty submit and one wrong-type submit

import every module for the runtime that executes it: no window or document in React Native, client hooks only in files marked 'use client', env read the way the bundler exposes it, and check which surface a component is imported from before fixing an undefined-component error

after adding a native module, a config plugin, or a native or bundler config change, run expo prebuild and rebuild (or restart with the cache cleared for env and bundler config) and confirm the change on a device; a hot reload is not evidence the change is live

before a deploy request, add the single-page-app catch-all rewrite to index.html and make the cookie secure flag depend on the environment; prove one deep-link refresh and one login and logout on each environment

make every charge, webhook and tool-called payment path idempotent and prove it by running it twice with the same idempotency key (exactly one charge); parse each webhook event type with its own payload shape; test store purchases on a real device or the store sandbox; live keys stay behind Gate-D

record the dependency versions the code was written against; run a docs or tutorial snippet as written and diff it against the installed versions before adopting it; extend an out-of-date vendor type locally with a note instead of casting it away
before calling a screen done, render it with zero records (every element and ref access guarded) and, on mobile, open each form with the keyboard up and prove no field or button is hidden

name the invalidation for every cached read and prove it: after a write the next read returns the new value, and the same cached route requested as two users never returns one user's data to the other

use one package manager per project, prove install and build with it, and record any forced resolution (legacy-peer-deps or an override) with the package that forced it instead of hand-editing versions
